item.text: {"rule":"The observations are insufficient to determine a general rule. Cards hearts and diamonds were discarded first each round, leaving spades and clubs; when spades was tapped, clubs was still named as the final card, while tapping clubs also yielded clubs. This suggests the last tap did not determine the final card, but the procedure is unclear."}
